metadata_versions.note: Metadata.cs rejects version <16 or >31 with 'ERROR: Metadata file supplied is not a supported version[N].'; v31 added in v6.7.46 (commit 'support v31'); README feature list says Unity 5.3 - 2022.2 (outdated vs source). Metadata >=35 (Unity 6000.3+) is unsupported.

mach_o.fat: prompts 'Select Platform: 1.64bit ...' via Console.ReadKey (throws when stdin is redirected) -> always pass a thin Mach-O

notes: Arguments are classified by content: a file starting with 0xFAB11BAF is the metadata, any other file is the binary, an existing directory is the output dir.
The output directory MUST already exist, otherwise outputs go to AppDomain.BaseDirectory (the tool directory).
config.json is read from AppDomain.CurrentDomain.BaseDirectory (the tool directory), NOT from the cwd -> run a private copy of the tool directory with a generated config.json.
Process exit code is 0 even when the dump failed (errors are only printed to stdout) -> success must be decided from output files and stdout markers.
Without 'RequireAnyKey: false' the tool ends with 'Press any key to exit...' and Console.ReadKey throws InvalidOperationException (exit code 134 / SIGABRT) when stdin is redirected (observed).

config.applied_note: DumpAttribute is false to keep dump.cs smaller (attribute dumping is the slowest part and is not needed for the summary); everything else keeps the shipped defaults except RequireAnyKey. ForceDump is only set when the request asks for it and only influences Mach-O by marking the file IsDumped.

field_semantics.RequireAnyKey: Program.cs: after Main finishes 'Press any key to exit...' + Console.ReadKey(true). Must be false for non-interactive use.
field_semantics.ForceIl2CppVersion/ForceVersion: Use ForceVersion to choose the il2cpp BINARY parser (not the metadata parser).
field_semantics.ForceDump: Treat the file as a memory dump (skips CheckDump). On ELF this triggers the 'Input il2cpp dump address' prompt; on Mach-O it only sets IsDumped.
field_semantics.NoRedirectedPointer: Only used together with ELF dump reload.
